preset_situations.title: Death Over Chase (Wankhede Thriller)
preset_situations.description: Rajasthan Royals need 32 runs from 14 legal deliveries with 5 wickets down. Required Rate: 13.71 RPO. Deep boundary riders posted.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Requires boundary conversion above 25% without sacrificing dot-ball minimization. Punishes high-risk lofted mis-hits.

preset_situations.title: Powerplay Collapse Rescue
preset_situations.description: Top-order blown away by swing in overcast conditions. Rebuild the innings while keeping the score above 6.5 RPO without losing another wicket.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Needs anchor stability, high positive-match share, and sound technique against moving balls with field restrictions.

preset_situations.title: The 20th Over Defense
preset_situations.description: Bowler has 10 runs to defend in the final over. Batter on strike is an aggressive finisher. Only 4 fielders permitted outside the 30-yard circle.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Demands pinpoint execution: wide yorkers, dipping slower balls, and zero boundary leakage. 1 mistake equals a match loss.

preset_situations.title: Middle Overs Spin Strangle
preset_situations.description: Opposition cruising at 68/1 after powerplay. Rajasthan Royals need to dry up boundaries, induce false shots, and force required rate up.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Requires tight lines, variable flight, dot-ball dominance, and suffocating defensive fields without conceding release boundaries.

preset_situations.title: Super Over Shootout
preset_situations.description: Scores tied at 178 all after 40 overs. Pure clutch execution. Win or go home.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Maximum boundary probability per delivery. Zero room for defensive defense.

preset_situations.title: Bowling vs Destructive Finishers
preset_situations.description: Opposition's most dangerous finisher is set on 35 off 14. Target is 40 off 18. Must bowl defensively to prevent 20-run overs.
preset_situations.tactical_demand: Must bowl wide outside off-stump, change pace, and avoid the hitting arc down the ground.
